frozen_scientific_scope.representation: fossil-specimen: internal mould of conjoined shell, not restored hollow living shell
frozen_scientific_scope.original_scope: Deep curved laterally compressed shell with offset dorsal umbo. Use real preserved internal-mould morphology; do not turn pegma impression into an exterior horn.

scale.basis: Approximate image measurement using published D1 x2.1, D2 x2.2, D3 x4 magnifications and PDF A4 size 595x842pt. At rendered 1800px page height, D1 length ~294px gives23.1mm; D2 ~302px gives22.8mm; D3 ~498px gives20.7mm. Differences from orientation/print layout retained as uncertainty, not averaged into false accuracy. D3 width ~157px gives6.5mm; D1 height ~180px gives14.1mm. Rounded working model22x13x6.5mm.
scale.tolerance: 15% overall approximate display scale; no direct specimen measurement. Width/length ~0.30 and height/length ~0.59.

uncertainty: Internal mould does not preserve shell thickness or pristine exterior. The original genus-level fossil-specimen proposal is retained, but represented as documented internal mould; not a full biological shell reconstruction.
Fine muscle scars and pegma depth are not metrically resolved. Bound cleft depth from D views and keep it anatomically local; do not invent through-holes.
Approximate scale comes from print magnifications, not caliper measurements; no millimetre-accurate replica claim.
Do not overstate the original adjective strongly offset: use actual specimen umbo position and curvature, without artificial exaggeration.
